notes: al-Faqih's statement of his routes («طرق») to Bakr b. Muhammad al-Azdi, with no saying (rule 11)
The text lists three routes and writes «عن بكر بن محمد الأزدي» once after them: the tail (rule 3)
The text does not say whether «محمد بن الحسن الصفار» also stands before أحمد بن إسحاق and إبراهيم بن هاشم: the groups are written as the text lists them
«- رضي اللّه عنه -» blessing left out
